gates.name: Identity and provenance
gates.acceptance_evidence: authenticated sender/receiver, full immutable identifiers, source state/version at use, signed correlation

gates.name: Representation integrity
gates.acceptance_evidence: frozen canonical bytes, independently computed digest and method-level verification results

gates.name: Governance and authorization
gates.acceptance_evidence: effective receiving rule, authenticated principal and independently evidenced institutional approval

gates.name: Atomic durable append
gates.acceptance_evidence: transactional append-only history, verified predecessor chain and owner-authoritative readback

gates.name: Recovery/replay
gates.acceptance_evidence: idempotent persisted attempt journal, crash replay and no historical overwrite demonstrated

gates.name: Independent result proof
gates.acceptance_evidence: receiving institution actual decision and resulting canonical record, separately verified
blocked_by: synthetic result asserted as issued object

policy: All are proposed evidence demands, not existing production contracts.
